showcase.title: The best slot catalog on the market
showcase.lead: Scalextric, Ninco, Avant Slot, Scaleauto and many more brands, in 1:32, 1:43 and 1:24. Each sheet brings together the reference, an image and technical data and, when they exist, an EAN and a link to the real-world race.
showcase.previewAria: Carousel of complete models, one from each brand

specs.label: several scales in the same catalog

open.label: browse without an account; sign in to rate and suggest

bullets: Search by reference, EAN, model or brand
Filters for brand, type, drivetrain, motor position, year and status
References in 1:32, 1:43 and 1:24
Technical sheet with dimensions, weight, magnet, gearing, lights and ratings
Correction suggestions and new listings, reviewed by the team
From the sheet to your garage: the new car opens with the reference filled in

collection.title: Your collection, linked to the catalog
collection.description: The catalog is the starting point. From a reference you move into your garage and complete photos, purchase data, setup and that car's history.
bullets: Add from the catalog by reference, or import a CSV
Photos from 6 views (front, sides, rear, top, chassis, 3/4)
Specs and components (motor, pinion, crown, guide, axles…)
Modifications with cost and a PDF export of the sheet
The car's record in completed competitions
Maintenance history and best-lap progress

inventory.title: Parts inventory
inventory.description: Parts and consumables with the same care as your collection: stock, prices and traceability down to the car you fit them on.
bullets: Categories, units, purchase price, dates and notes per item
Minimum stock, alerts and restocking when it is time to reorder
Filters by category, search and low-stock parts
Fit parts to cars from inventory (stock is deducted automatically)
Movement history and links to car modifications
Type-specific fields (material, gearing, and more)

timing.title: Timing and performance
timing.description: Record every lap on the web or sync it with Slot Database Lap Timer, the timer for the DS200. The desktop version is already available; the mobile apps have not launched yet.
bullets: Lap times with millisecond precision
Session analysis: progress, histogram and delta vs best lap
Compare sessions, setups and performance by lane
Correlation between voltage and performance
Training goals on the home dashboard
Slot Database Lap Timer on desktop, including offline. Mobile apps coming soon

competitions.title: Competitions, leagues and clubs
competitions.description: From a one-day event to the club season: public entry, standings and a driver profile you can share.
bullets: Competitions with circuits, categories and favourite drivers
Season leagues with discards, DNS, DNF, DSQ and points adjustments
Clubs with members, circuits, a calendar and a ranking
Public entry, live ranking and presentation mode (Live TV)
Public profile: record, podiums and best times per circuit
CSV and PDF results export

analytics.title: Dashboard and analytics
analytics.description: A panel that summarises spend, catalog coverage and performance so you can decide with data.
bullets: Collection metrics: cars, spend and trends
Charts by brand, type, shop and modifications
How much of your collection is linked to the reference catalog
Investment over time and top cars by cost
